page_id.description: IVTFF page name (e.g., f1r, f86v3, fRos)

line_number.description: Source locus ID within page (may have gaps - preserves original numbering)

line_index.description: Sequential index within page (always 1..n, no gaps)

text.description: Transcription text for this line with IVTFF markup, stripped, continuation lines joined (text_raw is the exact source text)

text_raw.description: The transliterated text exactly as in the source: after the locus identifier and the whitespace that follows it, to the end of the line (a wrapped locus keeps its continuation lines and line terminators)

locus_type.description: The IVTFF locus code as written, locator and locus type (IVTFF 2.0 Tables 8 and 9), e.g. @P0, &Lz

source_line.description: 1-based line number of the locus identifier in the source file

alternates.description: The readings of each uncertain reading [a:b] or [a:b:c], as written, most likely first

ligatures.description: The characters of each ligature {...}, as written

illegible.description: Each run of unreadable characters (?, or ??? for an unknown number), as written

high_ascii.description: Each high-ASCII code @NNN; in the transliterated text (not in comments)

comments.description: The text of each in-line comment <!...>

drawing_breaks.description: Each interruption by a drawing, as written (a word space)

markers.description: Each paragraph start <%>, paragraph end <$> and text tag <@X=y>, as written

text_clean.description: The normalization profile analysis-v1 of text_raw (vcat.profiles; the build report's text_clean_policy): ligature glyphs without braces, the first reading of each alternate, <-> and <~> as '.', '?' and the legacy EVA markers '!' '*' dropped, ',' kept, comments, paragraph marks, text tags, whitespace and wraps removed; glyphs as written

position.description: IVTFF locator, the locus position relative to the previous item (IVTFF 2.0 Table 8)

section.description: VCAT's one name for the page header's $I illustration type: a renaming of what the source states, the source's layer section_name (data_sources/layers.yaml); the metadata's section by folio ranges is VCAT's judgement

source_version.description: SHA256 hash prefix of source file

char_count.description: Count of EVA characters in clean text

has_uncertain.description: text holds a '?' (an unreadable character) outside comments, counting only the first reading of an alternate

has_illegible.description: text holds a legacy EVA illegibility marker '!' or '*' outside comments; never true for an IVTFF 2.0 EVA file
